description: Defines the VideoDecoderTestFixture class used for testing video decoders within the starboard player filter testing framework. Contains class declarations, constants, and includes relevant to video decoder testing.

classes.name: VideoDecoderTestFixture
classes.description: A fixture class for testing video decoder functionality, managing input buffers, decoder states, and event handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, setting up the decoder and related resources.

methods.name: OnDecoderStatusUpdate
methods.description: Handles status updates from the video decoder.

methods.name: WaitForNextEvent
methods.description: Waits for the next event with an optional timeout.

methods.name: WriteSingleInput
methods.description: Feeds a single input buffer into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: WriteMultipleInputs
methods.description: Feeds multiple input buffers into the decoder.

methods.name: DrainOutputs
methods.description: Drains decoded frames from the decoder.

methods.name: ResetDecoderAndClearPendingEvents
methods.description: Resets the decoder and clears queued events.

methods.name: GetVideoInputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves an input buffer for feeding data.

methods.name: UseInvalidDataForInput
methods.description: Marks an input buffer to contain invalid data for testing error handling.
